# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security updates are actively applied to the `main` branch and the latest GitHub Release.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Deyana is a local-first, privacy-focused desktop assistant. We take security and data privacy reports seriously.

Please **do not** report security vulnerabilities in public GitHub issues.

### How to Submit a Report

Submit reports privately using [GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/vkshdev/deyana/security/advisories/new):

1. Go to the **Security** tab of this repository.
2. Click **Report a vulnerability**.
3. Include minimal reproduction steps, affected component, and privacy impact.

We aim to acknowledge all private reports within 48 hours and release patches promptly.
